description: This file is a CMake module script defining a function 'compile_aidl' used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes documentation, licensing details, and the implementation of the function that invokes the aidl compiler with customizable options.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function that automates the process of compiling AIDL files into source code, with options for setting the language, include directories, target directory, compiler path, and additional flags.
